_note: v2.4 plan 02 follow-ups E3 + E3 completion live gate (02 gate record 'Follow-ups E3/E5 completion' NOT done list). No model call. Run: node scripts/debug/st-lanes.mts batch --lanes 2 --repeat 2 --strict --group 1759606632088 test/scenarios/live-v24-02-e3-save-evidence.json. Rows are read from the manager's session journal (rt.getSessionJournal(), kind 'story', summary '... not confirmed'), counted from a mark taken before each action. (1) /api/settings/save answers 500 at the transport (block_route): importing a story gives exactly one row 'library save not confirmed' labelled '“SO-E3 Save Evidence” v1'; removing it exactly one 'library removal not confirmed' labelled '“SO-E3 Save Evidence”'; clicking the settings-panel curator toggle (#so-curator-enabled, through its label with the panel open) exactly one 'settings save not confirmed' labelled 'stagecraft'. (2) Control, the stub removed: import, a Studio save of an edited description, removal and the toggle put back journal nothing, and the Studio toolbar says 'Saved “SO-E3 Save Evidence” vN to the library.' (the Studio save files the edit under the title-derived id, so every SO-E3 record is removed by title). (3) Dedupe, in a fresh sandbox chat: /api/chats/group/save answers 500 while the story is imported, so the selection write and the load's persist settle on one refused request: exactly one 'save not confirmed' row labelled 'story selection: …' and saveHealth.consecutiveFailures 1, not 2. The import leg also records whether a run token minted before the import still owns the page after it (the RunGuard journalSettingsWrite is given at write time) and every journal event since the mark. Every stub is removed by unblock_route, and by the runner's finally if the run dies; the curator toggle is put back in (2).

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; globalThis.__e3 = { marks: {}, seen: {}, legs: {} }; globalThis.__e3.rows = (since) => rt.getSessionJournal().filter((event) => event.kind === 'story' && /not confirmed/.test(event.summary) && event.at >= since).map((event) => ({ at: event.at, summary: event.summary, note: event.detail?.note ?? null })); globalThis.__e3.settle = async (since, want, ms) => { const end = Date.now() + ms; while (Date.now() < end && globalThis.__e3.rows(since).length < want) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 250)); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 4000)); return globalThis.__e3.rows(since); }; globalThis.__e3.curator = () => rt.getSnapshot().stagecraft.settings.curatorEnabled; globalThis.__e3.curatorBefore = globalThis.__e3.curator(); globalThis.__e3.marks.import = new Date().toISOString(); globalThis.__e3.token = rt.getOwnership().mint(null); return { curatorBefore: globalThis.__e3.curatorBefore, mark: globalThis.__e3.marks.import };

const store = globalThis.storyOrchestratorStudioDraft; if (!store) throw new Error('the Studio draft store is not exposed'); store.getState().mutate((draft) => ({ ...draft, description: `${draft.description} (E3 control edit)` })); if (!String(store.getState().draft.description).endsWith('(E3 control edit)')) throw new Error('the description edit did not land in the draft'); return { title: store.getState().draft.title };

await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 5000)); const modal = document.querySelector('#so-studio-modal'); const toolbar = (modal?.textContent ?? '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const sentence = toolbar.match(/(Saved|Saving)[^.]*?(to the library\.|not confirmed[^.]*\.)/)?.[0] ?? null; globalThis.__e3.sentence = sentence; const ok = /^Saved “SO-E3 Save Evidence” v\d+ to the library\.$/.test(sentence ?? ''); globalThis.__e3.legs.studio = { green: ok, problem: ok ? null : `the Studio toolbar does not say the save landed: ${JSON.stringify(sentence ?? toolbar.slice(0, 300))}`, sentence }; return globalThis.__e3.legs.studio;

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const ids = rt.getSnapshot().library.filter((record) => record.title === 'SO-E3 Save Evidence').map((record) => record.id); if (!ids.length) throw new Error('no SO-E3 record in the library to remove'); const removed = []; for (const id of ids) removed.push([id, await rt.removeStory(id)]); if (removed.some(([, ok]) => !ok)) throw new Error(`removeStory answered false: ${JSON.stringify(removed)}`); return { removed };

if (globalThis.__e3.curator() !== globalThis.__e3.curatorBefore) { const box = document.querySelector('#so-curator-enabled'); if (!box) throw new Error('#so-curator-enabled is not rendered'); const before = globalThis.__e3.curator(); box.closest('label').click(); for (let i = 0; i < 40 && globalThis.__e3.curator() === before; i += 1) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); if (globalThis.__e3.curator() === before) throw new Error('clicking the curator toggle did not change the setting (panel hidden?)'); } if (globalThis.__e3.curator() !== globalThis.__e3.curatorBefore) throw new Error('the curator toggle could not be put back'); const rows = await globalThis.__e3.settle(globalThis.__e3.marks.control, 1, 6000); globalThis.__e3.legs.control = { green: rows.length === 0, problem: rows.length ? `with the stub removed, something was journaled as not confirmed: ${JSON.stringify(rows)}` : null, rows }; const server = await fetch('/api/settings/get', { method: 'POST', headers: SillyTavern.getContext().getRequestHeaders(), body: '{}' }).then((r) => r.json()); const stored = JSON.parse(server.settings).extension_settings?.['story-orchestrator']; const curator = stored?.settings?.stagecraft?.curatorEnabled; if (curator !== undefined && curator !== globalThis.__e3.curatorBefore) throw new Error(`the server holds curatorEnabled ${curator}, expected ${globalThis.__e3.curatorBefore}`); const library = (stored?.v2Stories ?? []).filter((record) => record.title === 'SO-E3 Save Evidence'); if (library.length) throw new Error(`the server's library still holds ${library.length} SO-E3 record(s)`); return { control: globalThis.__e3.legs.control, curator: globalThis.__e3.curator(), serverCurator: curator ?? null };

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const greetings = ctx.chat.length; for (let id = ctx.chat.length - 1; id >= 0; id -= 1) await ctx.deleteMessage(id, undefined, false); if (ctx.chat.length !== 0) throw new Error(`the chat still holds ${ctx.chat.length} message(s) after clearing its greetings, so every message id below would name the wrong line`); return { greetingsCleared: greetings, chatId: ctx.chatId };
globalThis.__e3.marks.dedupe = new Date().toISOString(); return { mark: globalThis.__e3.marks.dedupe, chatId: SillyTavern.getContext().chatId };

const legs = globalThis.__e3.legs; const expected = ['import', 'remove', 'toggle', 'studio', 'control', 'dedupe']; const missing = expected.filter((leg) => !legs[leg]); const failed = expected.filter((leg) => legs[leg] && !legs[leg].green).map((leg) => `${leg}: ${legs[leg].problem}`); if (missing.length || failed.length) throw new Error(`E3 legs not green: ${JSON.stringify({ missing, failed })}`); return Object.fromEntries(expected.map((leg) => [leg, legs[leg].green]));
